questions.tip: Border rivers between Bihar & UP = Gandak, Ghaghra, Karmanasa. Option (D) More than one of the above.

questions.en: If 6 men and 8 boys can do a piece of work in 10 days, while 26 men and 48 boys can do the same work in 2 days, in how many days will 15 men and 20 boys finish the same work?
questions.hi: यदि 6 पुरुष और 8 लड़के किसी कार्य को 10 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, जबकि 26 पुरुष और 48 लड़के उसी कार्य को 2 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, तो 15 पुरुष और 20 लड़के उस कार्य को कितने दिनों में समाप्त करेंगे?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: (6M + 8B) * 10 = (26M + 48B) * 2 => 60M + 80B = 52M + 96B => 8M = 16B => 1 Man = 2 Boys. Total work in boy units = (6*2 + 8) * 10 = 20 * 10 = 200 boy-days. 15 men and 20 boys = 15*2 + 20 = 50 boys. Days required = 200 / 50 = 4 days.
questions.tip: 15M + 20B is exactly 2.5 times (6M + 8B). Since team strength is multiplied by 2.5, time is divided by 2.5: 10 / 2.5 = 4 days.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: (6M + 8B) * 10 = (26M + 48B) * 2 => 60M + 80B = 52M + 96B => 8M = 16B => 1 Man = 2 Boys. Total work in boy units = (6*2 + 8) * 10 = 20 * 10 = 200 boy-दिन. 15 men and 20 boys = 15*2 + 20 = 50 boys. दिन required = 200 / 50 = 4 दिन.
questions.tip_hi: 15M + 20B is exactly 2.5 times (6M + 8B). Since team strength is multiplied by 2.5, time is divided by 2.5: 10 / 2.5 = 4 दिन.

questions.en:
If day before yesterday it was Monday, then which will be the day on day after tomorrow?

questions.explanation: Day before yesterday = Monday -> Yesterday = Tuesday -> Today = Wednesday -> Tomorrow = Thursday -> Day after tomorrow = Friday.
questions.tip: Count displacement from 'day before yesterday' (-2) to 'day after tomorrow' (+2): total +4 days. Monday + 4 days = Friday.

questions.explanation_hi: Raj Kumar Shukla, an exploited peasant leader from Champaran, met महात्मा गांधी at the Lucknow Congress Session in दिसम्बर 1916 and persistently urged him to visit Champaran.
questions.tip_hi: Raj Kumar Shukla's persistent persuasion led directly to the historic Champaran Satyagraha of 1917, Gandhi's first Satyagraha experiment in India.

questions.en: The 27th Session of the Indian National Congress held in 1912 took place at which venue in Bihar?
questions.hi: 1912 में आयोजित भारतीय राष्ट्रीय काँग्रेस का 27वाँ अधिवेशन बिहार में कहाँ हुआ था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The 27th session of the INC met at Bankipore (Patna) in December 1912 under the presidency of Rao Bahadur Raghunath Narasinha Mudholkar (R.N. Mudholkar).
questions.tip: INC Sessions in Bihar sequence: 1912 Bankipore (R.N. Mudholkar); 1922 Gaya (C.R. Das); 1940 Ramgarh (Maulana Abul Kalam Azad).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The 27th session of the INC met at Bankipore (Patna) in दिसम्बर 1912 under the presidency of Rao Bahadur Raghunath Narasinha Mudholkar (R.N. Mudholkar).
questions.tip_hi: INC Sessions in Bihar sequence: 1912 Bankipore (R.N. Mudholkar); 1922 Gaya (C.R. Das); 1940 Ramgarh (Maulana Abul Kalam Azad).

questions.en: Who established the branch of 'Swaraj Dal' in Bihar in February 1923?
questions.hi: फरवरी 1923 में बिहार में 'स्वराज्य दल' की शाखा का गठन किसने किया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Following the Gaya Congress Session of 1922, a Bihar branch of the Swaraj Party was established in February 1923 under the leadership of Dr. Shri Krishna Singh (first Premier/Chief Minister of Bihar).
questions.tip: National founders = C.R. Das and Motilal Nehru; Bihar leader = Dr. Shri Krishna Singh ('Bihar Kesari').
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.tip_hi: National founders = C.R. Das and Motilal Nehru; Bihar leader = Dr. Shri Krishna Singh ('Bihar Kesari').

questions.en: The Tropic of Cancer (23°30' N latitude) passes through how many Indian States?(
questions.hi: कर्क रेखा (23°30' उत्तरी अक्षांश) भारत के कितने राज्यों से होकर गुजरती है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Tropic of Cancer traverses 8 Indian States from west to east: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram.
questions.tip: Mnemonic from West to East: 'GRM-CJ-WTM' -> Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The Tropic of Cancer traverses 8 Indian States from पश्चिम to पूर्व: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, पश्चिम Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram.
questions.tip_hi: Mnemonic from पश्चिम to पूर्व: 'GRM-CJ-WTM' -> Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, पश्चिम Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram.
